title: thelypteris engleriana
intro: Thelypteris engleriana, commonly known as the Engler's maiden fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is an herbaceous perennial plant native to Southeast Asia, used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing and the management of fever and cough. The bioactive constituents of Thelypteris engleriana include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
